sources.text: Primary topology/cache/partial softmax merge and stage-transfer concepts only. Authored contiguous PCP chunks, fixed-capacity contiguous DCP slots, three-reduction stable merge, artificial rates and standalone attention stages are explicit mathematical choices, not a literal vLLM kernel/cache implementation or full model. PCP: contiguous even query chunks with original causal offsets; current K/V AllGather, full replicated KV cache and local causal attention. This intentionally differs from head-tail balancing. Outputs remain query-sharded. All rates are artificial. Dense rectangular executed work and causal/valid useful work are separate. Network-only collectives do not invent local HBM, staging or reduction arithmetic. Softmax/exp vector costs are explicitly authored proxies, not a runtime kernel prediction.
